card.name: Start of a surname after a first name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a surname split into parts, such as Mer, Ber, Cl or Don, right after a first name or initial in author lines, bylines and citations. It also fires on Mer in a place or genus name.

modes.label: Surname after first name
modes.description: The opening piece of a person's last name follows a first name or middle initial.
modes.example: Eleanor<< Cl>>ift on the strategy behind the move.

modes.label: Author lists and citations
modes.description: The opening piece of an author's surname in a reference or author list.
modes.example: Pohl, N.;<< Cl>>ague, A.; Schwarz, K.

modes.label: Place or taxon names
modes.description: The opening piece of a rare proper name such as a river or plant genus.
